items.headline: Iran sanctions move from scheduled catalyst to same-day China oil and secondary-sanctions risk
items.category: Geopolitics / Energy / China / Inflation / Capital Allocation
items.summary: Reuters reports that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is due to present new Iran measures on 24 August while China remains the largest destination for Iranian crude. Kpler data cited by Reuters show provisional Chinese intake of Iranian oil falling to about 534,000 barrels per day in August from 823,000 in July as the U.S. blockade and sanctions pressure disrupt flows.
items.whyItMatters: The risk is now concentrated in execution details: whether Washington targets Chinese refiners, banks, shipping or trade intermediaries will determine the next move in crude, freight, inflation expectations and China risk assets. AGCI treats the announcement as an event-risk window, not a reason to chase oil after a large move.
items.agciSignal: SAME-DAY SANCTIONS CATALYST / CHINA SECONDARY-RISK / KEEP OPTIONALITY

items.headline: AI capex estimates are being revised at historic speed as hyperscaler spending outruns Wall Street models
items.category: AI / Technology / Capex / Valuation / Capital Allocation
items.summary: Barron's reports that Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and Oracle collectively spent about $330 billion in the first half of 2026 and that analysts expect roughly $469 billion more in the second half. Its analysis says major data-center operators could exceed $1 trillion of capex in 2027, with initial fiscal-2027 estimates for the five companies revised upward by an average 183%, far above the prior-decade average revision rate.
items.whyItMatters: The AI thesis is shifting from demand validation to return-on-capital validation. Suppliers can continue to benefit from the buildout, but hyperscalers now need to prove utilization, monetization and FCF after capex. With long yields high, AGCI raises the hurdle rate and separates self-funded platforms from companies dependent on external financing.
items.agciSignal: AI CAPEX > MODELS / ROI TEST INTENSIFIES / FAVOR SELF-FUNDED QUALITY

items.headline: Dollar trades near multi-month lows as debt and long-bond intervention concerns remain unresolved
items.category: FX / Bonds / Fiscal / Macro / Capital Allocation
items.summary: Reuters reports the dollar near multi-month lows after Treasury doubled long-dated bond buybacks to $4 billion per operation. Long-end yields remain elevated on inflation, growth and sovereign-debt concerns, while gold and bitcoin have benefited from diversification and debasement fears.
items.whyItMatters: Treasury buybacks can improve market functioning but do not remove the fiscal term-premium problem. AGCI therefore keeps duration staggered, avoids interpreting tactical yield relief as a structural all-clear, and preserves exposure to real-asset hedges without chasing.
items.agciSignal: LONG-END TERM PREMIUM UNRESOLVED / DOLLAR PRESSURE / STAGGER DURATION

items.headline: China property remains a slow-burn balance-sheet drag despite more than 7 trillion yuan of support
items.summary: Barron's argues that Evergrande's collapse has not ended China's housing adjustment. It cites more than 7 trillion yuan of lending toward viable projects while residential starts, completions and home sales continue to contract materially; local authorities are easing purchase and down-payment rules to stabilize demand.
items.whyItMatters: The key investment implication is persistence rather than a new crash: household confidence, developer balance sheets and local-government finances can remain weak for years. AGCI avoids treating isolated Chinese equity rallies as proof that the property cycle has normalized.
items.agciSignal: CHINA PROPERTY = SLOW DRAG / DO NOT CONFUSE POLICY SUPPORT WITH NORMALIZATION

items.headline: Greed remains 87 and valuation 85 as the market enters a compressed catalyst week
items.summary: The 24 August AGCI snapshot keeps Greed at 87/100 and Valuation at 85/100. Regime remains Mid Bull, confidence 72/100 and the matrix remains EUPHORIA_RISK — Capital preservation / Do not chase; the S&P 500 and VIX inputs still reflect the 21 August close.
items.whyItMatters: There has been no broad valuation reset before a week containing Iran sanctions, July PCE/GDP, Nvidia earnings and Jackson Hole. AGCI keeps liquidity and entry discipline rather than adding broad beta into event concentration.
items.agciSignal: EXTREME GREED + EXTREME VALUATION / CATALYST CLUSTER / PRESERVE LIQUIDITY
